pre_safety_verification.note: Superseded integration run retained separately; final gates below include the focused fallible-allocation correction.

limitations: No fresh native Excel execution is available. Saved source caches, published contracts, independently recalculated Calc probes and the user-confirmed Excel publication rule remain distinct evidence.
Current source-bound reports supersede historical hashes only for the listed suites; earlier observations, provenance and falsified hypotheses remain preserved.

Bounded selector and exact-predicate arrays are supported under ExcelDocumentation; no general function vectorization, unbounded named-producer inference or coordinate-lazy compound interpreter is claimed.
IFS/SWITCH/CHOOSE retain established scalar policies, lazy unused-shape behavior and uniform incompatible-extent rejection; documented Calc omission, Boolean admission and padding differences remain.

The explicitly project-contract lookup-blanks scenario expectation was separately superseded by the user-authorized worksheet publication rule; original new compatibility expectations were not changed.
